name: Ruou Kim Son
summary: Rượu Kim Sơn is the drink the tourism overview names with goat and cơm cháy. The culture page’s jar wine, rượu cần, is a different sentence. Do not treat them as one bottle.
origin: Kim Sơn, Ninh Bình, on the tourism overview.
howToEat: How to drink it was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ruou Kim Son — the overview’s drink
seoDescription: Rượu Kim Sơn, named with goat and crisp rice on the tourism overview, kept apart from rượu cần.
